quests.title: Delicious Riddle

dialogue.t: Nara friend! Arama has told many stories of you. You are a Nara full of courage and wisdom. Come challenge Araesha's riddles!
Good Nara! Araesha's riddles are tasty!
Oh... Don't forget, Nara friend. Araesha will wait here.
This one is easy! There are more delicious riddles to follow, so come again.
This is easy too. Aranara all know it. Good Nara is Aranara's friend and naturally knows it. Let me give you one more riddle.
Good Nara! All correct! Good Nara is a clever Nara.
Hmm, wrong answer. Please think again, good Nara.
Round and red and good to eat, it hangs on a tree, moist and sweet.
It exists in dreams and no other place, a must for Festival Utsava space.
This one is difficult. Even Araja wouldn't know it! There are stars in the sky, and it is on the land. Stars cannot see the sun, and it doesn't love the sun either.
Clever Nara! Smarter than Araja! Would Nara be willing to be Araesha's friend?
Yes! Flower for you. Araesha will think of more good riddles. Come play with Araesha again, friend!

quests.description: The resourceful Araesha has prepared “delicious” riddles for Festival Utsava.
